origin.description: Encode an object and gzip the JSON.
origin.details: The gzip header stores a time, so two compressions of the same text can differ as bytes.

translation.description: Uses gzip.compress on the UTF-8 JSON.
translation.example:
import gzip
from jsonlite import as_gzjson_raw
print(gzip.decompress(as_gzjson_raw({"a": 1})).decode())
